seoTitle: Arlington ISD Calendar 2025-2026 | Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Arlington ISD Calendar 2025-2026 including first day, holidays, parent conference days, winter break, spring break, early release dates, printable PDF, ICS, and Google Calendar download.
calendarNotes: Arlington ISD starts the 2025-2026 school year on August 13, 2025 and ends on May 22, 2026. Thanksgiving Break runs November 24-28, Winter Break runs December 22-January 2, and Spring Break runs March 16-20. The official calendar also lists teacher preparation and professional learning days, secondary exam days, elementary parent conference notes, open house dates, early release schedules, and an inclement weather make-up day on March 23.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Arlington ISD start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Wednesday, August 13, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Arlington ISD Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 16 through Friday, March 20, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Arlington ISD in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Friday, May 22, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Arlington ISD have alternate calendars for 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Arlington ISD also publishes a 2025-2026 A/B Calendar and a 2025-2026 Early College High School calendar.

customSections.label: Arlington ISD Calendar Overview 2025-2026
customSections.content:
The Arlington ISD 2025-2026 academic calendar provides districtwide student dates for school-year planning. Families can use it to track the first day of school, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, student and staff holidays, student holidays, professional learning days, secondary exam days, elementary parent conference notes, open house dates, and the last day of school.

This page summarizes the official calendar into key dates, a downloadable calendar file, and a printable PDF source. Families should still verify campus-specific events, testing schedules, athletics, graduation details, and emergency updates through Arlington ISD.

customSections.label: Other Arlington ISD Calendars for 2025-2026
customSections.content: Arlington ISD also publishes alternate calendars for A/B schedules and Early College High School. Use the districtwide calendar for most student planning, then check the alternate calendar that applies to your program.

customSections.label: How We Verify Arlington ISD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official Arlington ISD calendars page and published academic calendar PDFs, compares key dates such as first day, last day, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, student holidays, parent conference days, early dismissal and exam windows, and alternate-calendar links, then converts the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

The official Arlington ISD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, emergency closures, and same-day announcements.
